channel.title: Soliloquy blog
channel.description: Notes on speaking practice, language learning, and the method behind Soliloquy. No fluent-in-3-months promises, no prices.

item.title: I understand Spanish, but I can't speak it. It's not a talent problem
item.description: You understand Spanish, but your mind goes blank when you speak. It's not a lack of talent: you trained recognition for years, not speaking.
item.dc:creator: Sławomir Onyszko

item.title: Language learning for beginners: speak, correct, review
item.description: Beginner advice often looks like a shopping list. A better strategy is to speak your own sentences, get specific corrections, and review them before you forget.
item.dc:creator: Sławomir Onyszko

item.title: Your first speaking session: how to start without an audience
item.description: Your first speaking session does not need an audience or a correction. A few known words and your voice are enough. Here is how to start alone, tonight.
item.dc:creator: Sławomir Onyszko

item.title: How to learn words so they stay in your head
item.description: Learning more words is not the same as speaking. Here is how to learn words in context, use them in your own sentences, and review them before they fade.
item.dc:creator: Sławomir Onyszko

item.title: How to build a daily speaking habit that survives a busy week
item.description: A daily speaking habit is not about motivation. It is about a short loop you can repeat on a busy day. Here is how to make speaking practice stick.
item.dc:creator: Sławomir Onyszko

item.title: A year of daily speaking practice: what actually changes
item.description: A year of daily practice can change how you speak, but nobody can promise a level by a date. Here is what actually changes, and what it takes.
item.dc:creator: Sławomir Onyszko
